title: chamaecrista brachyrachis
intro: Chamaecrista brachyrachis, commonly known as the short-spiked partridge pea, is a plant species in the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chamaecrista brachyrachis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Chamaecrista brachyrachis, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
